scientific_integrity: A complete proof and explicitly bounded independent finite regression tests are provided; exact nonintegral- and quota-one boundaries are addressed; all presented calculations use rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted approvals, integer committee size, every candidate degree at most the unrounded Hare quota; counterexample refutes universal collapse above the cap, not existence. Payment dual characterization from arXiv:2609.11912 is used as published. Historical priority not independently established.
title: Quota-bounded approval support collapses core, core+, and justified representation, with a sharp one-voter breach
